wiki.title: Chris Pappas (American politician)
wiki.extract: Christopher Charles Pappas ( PAPP-əss; born June 4, 1980) is an American politician who is the United States senator-elect from New Hampshire. A member of the Democratic Party, Pappas has served as the U.S. representative from New Hampshire's 1st congressional district since 2019. He also served on the New Hampshire Executive Council from 2013 to 2019.
